description: This file defines a Catalyst controller class for managing shop sections within a project. It includes methods for listing, creating, updating, and deleting shop sections, with associated URL routing and access control.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::ShopSection
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing shop sections within a project.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET/HEAD requests to list all shop sections with article counts, generating URLs for update and delete actions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new shop section, with duplicate name check.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures a shop section by ID for subsequent actions, or detaches if not found.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update the name of a specific shop section.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a specific shop section if deletable.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Private method to redirect to the index page.
